text:
Nora: Quick follow-up on the DB outage postmortem actions. We keep missing closure on remediations. Can we standardize a tiny tracker and ownership rules?

Evan: Absolutely. My proposal: single source of truth (Airtable or Sheet), each row = action. Minimal fields: action, owner, due_date, verify_cmds, status, pattern_tag. Make owner required on creation.

Priya: I'll volunteer to sketch the Airtable base. Add a field for "recurring?" with frequency (none/weekly/monthly/quarterly). That will help automation.

Sam: For verification we should record exact test commands and a "stability window" (e.g., 24h). Example row: 
- Action: Rotate read-replica config
  Owner: @Priya
  Due: 2025-11-10
  Verify: `./smoke-check --db-replicas` + monitor 24h
  Recurring: quarterly

Kai: IC handoffs were messy. I suggest 1-week IC shifts, explicit Slack handoff message, and a pinned IC checklist in the channel. Handoff message template: `IC HANDOFF: from @oldIC to @newIC | status: <short> | blocking actions: <list>`

Nora: Good. Also propose a weekly 15-min follow-up slot (Tuesday 9:30) just to tick through open PM actions. Keep it optional for owners but require an update in the tracker each week.

Evan: I'll set up the tracker and automation: reminders on due_date and a weekly digest to the channel listing overdue items and recurrence trends.

Priya: Can we add an "incident pattern" tag per action (replication/deploy/latency/monitoring)? Then we can run a quarterly report for repeated patterns.

Sam: For comms cadence during incidents: initial ack <= 3m, owner-assigned within 15m, status updates every 30-60m depending on severity, final follow-up + postmortem stub within 24h. For remediation: owners must post an initial plan in 48h.

incident-bot: Reminder: 4 open actions from latest PM. Owners: @Priya, @Sam, @Evan, @Kai. Reply `ack` to snooze.

Nora: Action list from this thread: 
- Priya: build Airtable base + sample rows + runbook link (due 2025-11-05)
- Evan: populate current open actions into tracker + enable reminders (due 2025-10-31)
- Kai: draft IC handoff message + pinned IC checklist (due 2025-11-02)
- Sam: capture verification commands for DB actions and tag patterns (due 2025-11-04)

Priya: Acknowledged. Will post base URL here when ready.

Evan: Will DM owners to confirm due dates and accept ownership.

Nora: Thanks. We'll use the Tuesday 9:30 slot to glance through the tracker. If anyone needs to change an owner or timeline, update the tracker and ping the channel. :white_check_mark:
